title: Cognitive Chain-of-Thought: Structured Multimodal Reasoning about Social Situations
benchmark_measurement: The paper focuses on structured multimodal reasoning for social situations, including intent disambiguation, commonsense reasoning, and safety-critical judgments. The benchmarks do not measure any aspects of faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith.
